At Euromouldings in Nijverdal, you work as a production employee in a 5-shift system, which means you not only earn a good salary but also have extra free time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that plastic bottles and jerrycans are produced and packaged perfectly.

A job where you are actively engaged, work with technology, and every shift is different. Sounds good? Then be sure to read on 👇

Wat wordt er van je verwacht
As a production worker at Euromouldings in Nijverdal, you are an important link in the production process. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that the machines keep running and that every product meets quality requirements.

You work in a 5-shift system, which keeps your work varied and gives you plenty of free time. During your shift, you are constantly busy: you maintain an overview, intervene where necessary, and ensure that everything runs neatly and efficiently.

Specifically, what you will be doing:
- You pack plastic bottles and jerrycans in a neat and careful manner
- You check the quality of products and identify deviations
- You measure products using tools such as a caliper
- You assist in keeping the production lines running
- You work together with colleagues to ensure production runs smoothly

In short: you ensure that everything is right — from production to packaging.

For this position, we are not looking for a perfect CV, but the right attitude. Do you recognize yourself in this?
- You are 18 years or older
- You can work and think at an MBO (intermediate vocational education) level
- You are flexible and have no problem working in a 5-shift system
- You work accurately and have an eye for quality
- You can collaborate well and maintain an overview in a busy environment
- You speak Dutch and/or English
